title: Alcohol: The Cup Of Confusion
body:
15 Minutes w/ The Captains · 2026-01-30

Opens [1 Cor 6](/bible/1-corinthians/6) · [Ps 104](/bible/psalms/104) · [Eccl 9](/bible/ecclesiastes/9) · [Prov 20](/bible/proverbs/20) · [Prov 23](/bible/proverbs/23) · [Isa 28](/bible/isaiah/28) · [Sir 19](/bible/sirach/19) · [Sir 31](/bible/sirach/31) · [Deut 28](/bible/deuteronomy/28) · [Hos 4](/bible/hosea/4) · [Sir 2](/bible/sirach/2)
## Introduction *[[0:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38&t=13s)]* Hey, shalom. Israel most high in Christ bless. Captain Paloo here. Today's 15 minutes with the captains, we're going to go over alcoholism. And the reason why I'm going over that, because that goes kind of under the wayside. Brothers and sisters, you know, whatever the case may be, have a drink or whatever. Sometimes it can go too far. We going to go through the bases of alcohol. I know a lot of times the Christian church say you can't drink. That's a lie. Drink is fine. Alcohol is fine. Wine is fine. Strong drink and wine is fine, but it's only so much you can do. You can't do it to where you are drunk. So this is for you. If you having problems with alcohol, this is for you. Today's topic is called alcohol, the cup of confusion. So first, alcohol is not evil in moderation, but drunkenness is a weapon used against Israel to weaken judgment, families, and obedience to God. This thing alters everything if we don't use alcohol in its proper form. It's for you to feel all right and that's it. Not to go no further, not to be drunk, not to be doing all these other things, because alcohol does what? It alter your mind a little bit. That's why it's called spirits. When you go to a liquor store, it's called spirits, right? Liquor and spirits, wine and spirits. So, it does put spirits on you. And you got to be wise in what you're doing. ## Scriptures Opened **[1 Corinthians 6:12](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v12)** *[[2:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38&t=120s)]* > [12](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v12) All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any. - All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: alcohol or wine, strong drink or wine, it is lawful. It is lawful to drink an alcoholic beverage. It is lawful according to the Bible. But sometime it's not expedient, and it can vary from different person. Everybody can't drink. You got to know your limits. Some people ain't got no limit. One drink, you done. You got to know that about yourself. Some people, if they get one drink, they're going to keep drinking and keep drinking and keep drinking. Now you're going to be in the midst of sin, because eventually you fall into the midst of drunkenness. We're trying to keep you from that. So alcohol and wine, it's lawful, but sometime it isn't expedient for you. - But I will not be brought under the power of any: but guess what? You don't need to be brought under the power of it, because alcohol, wine, strong drink, whatever it is, hooch or whatever you want to call it, that thing can have power over you. It has destroyed us. Look at our neighborhoods. You see a liquor store on every corner. It is a reason for it. It ain't a crack house on every corner. It ain't a heroin place that they say, "Oh, this is a heroin shop right here." It's alcohol, wine, and that's where we go to drink our problems away. - So, alcohol becomes sin when it brings us under its power. Alcohol is not just a habit. It is bondage. Spiritual bondage. **[Psalms 104:14-15](/bible/psalms/104#v14)** *[[4:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38&t=248s)]* > [14](/bible/psalms/104#v14) He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth; > > [15](/bible/psalms/104#v15) And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart. - God's law on alcohol. Moderation versus drunkenness. - And wine that maketh glad the heart of man: the Lord created wine or strong drink for the man to feel good at some point, right? He made that thing. Matter of fact, wine and alcohol comes from the earth. It comes from fruits and vegetables. That's what it comes from. So, it's actually in the earth. But he made it for us to feel merry, but he didn't make it for us to fall into drunkenness. It's a difference. Wine maketh glad the heart of man. That make you feel good. - And bread which strengtheneth man's heart: so these are things that the Lord provided a man, right? To have a good time. You want to have a good time, have a little drink here and there, that's cool, right? So it's fine to do that, but you can't overindulge in that. **[Ecclesiastes 9:7](/bible/ecclesiastes/9#v7)** *[[5:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38&t=336s)]* > [7](/bible/ecclesiastes/9#v7) Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works. - I'm telling you alcohol is permitted, but do not let this thing destroy you. It can destroy many things, and we going to get into that. - And drink thy wine with a merry heart: he said drink the wine with a merry heart. It's all right to do it. That's why he said, "All things are lawful unto me, but everything isn't expedient." Everybody isn't meant to do it. I noticed me personally, when I first came in the truth, cuz remember we come out of Christianity. We think we can't drink. We think we in the midst of sin. So, we understand that, oh, listen, I can have a drink and it's lawful. I ain't got to pray afterwards and all that. When I say I could do that, guess what I'mma do? I was like, we gonna have a drink. And that's what we did. We have a little drink and all this stuff, man. Sometime we go over the scriptures here and there, but we ain't doing that in drunkenness. We make merry. You know what I'm saying? But some things, man, just not expedient for people. Some people can't handle it. - But I noticed that later on, as I got older, I stopped wanting to drink. I don't drink as often as I used to. I don't know if it's me just getting older or whatever. But I don't drink as much as I used to, you know, and it's just a preference. Nobody have seen me drunk. Not one person, not even close to being drunk, right? But it's just something that I just stopped doing. Every once in a while, you will see me do that. But it's just something I'm not into. But other people, they don't know how to stop. They drink, but they don't know their limits. Or they know their limits and they don't give a damn, and they go behind their limits, and that's what it is. So, it's lawful, but let's make sure that we not in the midst of drunkenness, because it destroys you. It could destroy your family, because drunkenness can condemn you. **[Proverbs 20:1](/bible/proverbs/20#v1)** *[[7:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38&t=470s)]* > [1](/bible/proverbs/20#v1) Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise. - This is exactly what I mean by the scriptures. Listen, the Lord knows. The Lord ain't tempting us now. He gave it to you. He told you what it's for, for you to be merry and all this. He told you what not to do. Don't overindulge, because you're going to be in the midst of sin, drunkenness, and ain't no drunken going to make it to the kingdom of heaven. Period. So, it's certain laws and bylaws around alcohol, right? Strong drink and the wine, that you got to abide by. So you can't say, "Oh, God tempted. Why he put it here if I can't get drunk? Why he put it here if I can't overindulge?" - Wine is a mocker: it said wine is a mocker. The wine will mock you. You think you had a couple of drinks, man. Next thing you know, man, make you look stupid as hell after a while. You don't know your limits. You might not even remember what you did the day before. That's when it's bad. You don't even remember. They got you on camera. You bugged out, or you sleep, you passed out in the back. Wine would mock you if you don't know how to handle it. - Strong drink is raging: and some people, when they drink, they get violent. They get violent. They get real touchy with you and all this stuff. All the past stuff that they didn't felt, it all start coming up. You know what I mean? Once that alcohol hit that system, you start feeling yourself. You start feeling yourself and things go wrong. - And whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise: right? Because some of y'all feel like it don't pertain to you. You ain't listening. You ain't knowing your limits. And what happened? Your behind is mocked. You an embarrassment. You embarrassed your whole household. Your wife don't even want to come to the Sabbath no more because your ass was passed out outside. Slurring your words and all them things, right? Come on, man. That ain't what we here for. You know what I'm saying? And we done seen it at Tabernacles, Passovers and all this, men's conferences. Brothers drink a little too much. I understand you having a good time with brothers. Know your damn limits. And you sisters too. Some of y'all ass don't know how to drink, and then you're talking crazy. You're telling your business, telling your husband's business, telling your sex life to other sisters, all that stuff. Your mouth get to talking, because of that liquor in you. **[Proverbs 23:29-35](/bible/proverbs/23#v29)** *[[10:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38&t=652s)]* > [29](/bible/proverbs/23#v29) Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes? > > [30](/bible/proverbs/23#v30) They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine. > > [31](/bible/proverbs/23#v31) Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright. > > [32](/bible/proverbs/23#v32) At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder. > > [33](/bible/proverbs/23#v33) Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things. > > [34](/bible/proverbs/23#v34) Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast. > > [35](/bible/proverbs/23#v35) They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again. - Who hath redness of eyes? They that tarry long at the wine: they tarry long at the wine. Constantly drinking. They go to sleep. They wake up. They just constantly, they get one drink, then they got another one. They get another one. Eyes red, bloodshot red, you slurring at the mouth. All these things happen. - At the last it biteth like a serpent: you just drinking whatever, but next thing you know, it starts sneaking up on you and it bite you in the behind. You went from one drink, now you at drink 10. It came and bit you in the behind, because you don't know how to control your intake of alcohol or wine or whatever the case may be. Strong drink, all the same. You don't know how to control yourself. It keeps you from being disciplined. You end up lacking the judgment. It destroys your judgment, your discipline, when you overdrink, when you're not being conscious of what you consuming. You got to be mindful of that. - Thine eyes shall behold strange women: and that's what happened. You get bold, too. You get bold at the eyes. You be drinking now. Hey, what's up? Everything that you've once thought of somebody, it end up coming out. That's what happened when you're drinking. The real you come out. You start seeing stuff. I'm telling you, all that stuff come out. The real you show up. The representative is no longer there. It's you. - And thine heart shall utter perverse things: and then you start saying crazy things, nasty stuff. You see a sister, you could do that in here in the body. You had a few drinks, we hang, you having a good time. You say something crazy. Somebody's wife. You know what I'm saying? What the hell is wrong with you? Get your ass whooped. Talking to somebody wife like that. What the hell is wrong with you? It happens. Don't get it twisted. It happens. So you got to be mindful of that. - They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick: I wasn't sick. I wasn't drunk. - They have beaten me, and I felt it not: hey, that happens. A lot of y'all came out of the club, and now you in the body now. Now you trying to get yourself together. You done went to the club and was drunk and don't remember nothing. You got beat down. You got beat up. You wake up, your shirt ripped. You got throw up everywhere. Something wrong with you, cuz you done drunk so much. You done overindulged. Now you are mocked. People got it on camera. You on social media, you on World Star, you on TikTok, Twitter, you on everything, because your behind do not know how to govern yourself when it comes to the wine, to the cup. - When shall I awake? I will seek it yet again: I'mma get back to drinking. I'mma go right back to drinking. Hangover. And when you become an alcoholic, hangovers become normal. Now you've got to drink to keep the hangover off of you. Now you got to drink to keep that headache up off of you, to feel normal again. You see how alcohol messes you up? You see why it's a spirit? You got to be mindful of that. You got to have self-control. **[Isaiah 28:7](/bible/isaiah/28#v7)** *[[16:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38&t=961s)]* > [7](/bible/isaiah/28#v7) But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment. - But they also have erred through wine: they've erred through wine. They've sinned. They had mistakes through wine. - The priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink: so don't get it twisted. Just because you may see a leader don't mean that they don't battle that, or that they can't have access of wine and slip and fall and err. It surely can happen. That's why we got to be careful when we up here at the leadership table. What it look like if you see us drunk up here? You wouldn't respect nothing we say. You won't respect any judgments that we'll try to put forth. We not even in the mindset to do so if we was like that. So we got to make sure our mind is clear when it comes to that. We can't be drunk. We got to be sober minded if you want to judge people and have that discipline. - They err in vision: when you a drunk, when you got a drunk leader, you don't have vision, because you being a drunken mean that you're dealing with something that you have not fixed yet. So you can't have no vision. - They stumble in judgment: they do what? They stumble in judgment. And you not being in your right mind, you're not going to make the proper judgments that need to happen if you're always at the bottle. You always at the wine. We see it all the time. Brothers be trying to be online drinking while they trying to break down scriptures and be completely wrong. We've seen it multiple time, breaking it all the way down, like what the hell is this talking about. Y'all know who the hell I'm talking about. Not like y'all don't know what I'm talking about. Be breaking stuff down wrong. But listen, we got to be mindful of that. **[Sirach 19:1-2](/bible/sirach/19#v1)** *[[18:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38&t=1110s)]* > [1](/bible/sirach/19#v1) A labouring man that A is given to drunkenness shall not be rich: and he that contemneth small things shall fall by little and little. > > [2](/bible/sirach/19#v2) Wine and women will make men of understanding to fall away: and he that cleaveth to harlots will become impudent. - Is given to drunkenness shall not be rich: shall not be rich. You know why? Because what did he do? You've worked all day. And what happens when you get off? You go right to the damn liquor store. You drink one bottle, one pint, and you go get another one, or you do it before you went to work. You know what I'm saying? Just constantly. And work is related to it. You stressed at work. You working all day. You stressed out. Boss get on your nerves. What you want to do? You pissed off. You want to go get the drink. Then you don't want to go home. Why? Cuz your wife is nagging you all the time. She need this, this, and that. Then you go to the bar. Next thing you know, you at a whole strip club doing some crazy stuff. Who knows? You throwing all your money. You know what I'm saying? Meaning, you're not going to make wise decisions. You laboring all day, but you're still not making wise decisions. - And he that contemneth small things shall fall by little and little: when you despise small things, you fall little by little. But guess what? It goes hand in hand with things. - Wine and women will make men of understanding to fall away: like I was mentioning earlier, wine and women, it goes hand in hand. It can go hand in hand and vice versa. So we got to be mindful of that. Your mind start going other ways. You start looking at people a different way and all this stuff. Then you get the courage. What do they call that? You get that liquid courage. That's what you get. The liquid courage. And liquid courage will get you in some trouble. I'm telling you, you don't want them problems. **[Sirach 31:29-30](/bible/sirach/31#v29)** *[[20:37](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38&t=1237s)]* > [29](/bible/sirach/31#v29) But wine drunken with excess maketh bitterness of the mind, with brawling and quarrelling. > > [30](/bible/sirach/31#v30) Drunkenness increaseth the rage of a fool till he offend: it diminisheth strength, and maketh wounds. - But wine drunken with excess maketh bitterness of the mind: it maketh bitterness of the mind. Make your mind not clear. - Drunkenness increaseth the rage of a fool till he offend: it increases him. I'm telling you, it gives you that liquid courage we just talking about. When you one of them brothers that get angry, or you indulge yourself. You're going through some things and you just choose to over drink. What happens? You start to build up that old anger from something, that stuff in deep that you ain't fix come out. And what happens? It shows up. It shows that rage. You go out and you take it out on your wife. You got to take it out on your kids, other people. They ain't got nothing to do with your problems. But you do that. - It diminisheth strength, and maketh wounds: it said diminish your strength. It diminishes your strength. You become weak. Your mind ain't there. Your mind ain't strong. Your mind ain't sober. You become weak to the liquor. You don't make sound judgments at all. Alcohol erodes discipline, which Israel must have to keep the commandments. - Now I'm just going to go through some biblical examples. I'm not going to go through the scripture because I don't have much time. You got Noah that brought shame to a point, but also it exposed who Ham was. If you go read Genesis 9:21, you can read up a little bit. It talks about what happened. You know, Noah was drunk, and then you had Ham that went over there and seen his nakedness. Which Noah shouldn't have been drunk in the first place. You know what I'm saying? So, it caused a ripple effect down the line. And what ended up happening was, Shem and Japheth turned around, cuz they knew what was happening. That's why Ham is something else. We find out later on, where Lot there, Sodom and Gomorrah, them nasty. Ham is something else. So it's in him. But they turned around like, we ain't trying to see no. We don't want no smoke. Then Noah woke up and blessed them and cursed Ham. - Then you got Lot. His daughters even got him drunk and slept with him. Now you got Moab. Now you see why them Asian people eyes is like this. Why? Because it's incest. It is consequences to things that happen. It is cause and effect. This is what happened. - And then you got Nabal, not listening to judgment. Getting drunk, having parties, got a whole wife. Who knows what was going on in the house, and lo, Most High God killed him. If you go back and read that in 1st Samuel 25, you know, David could put the paws on him. And Abigail was like, "Nah, we ain't having that. That's my husband still." You know what I'm saying? But guess what? The Lord judged him because he didn't want to listen. So, don't be that person. - So, why alcoholism is harder to break than other addictions: because it's social. Alcohol is socially accepted. It's also legally accessible, culturally celebrated. Everything we do, we have a drink, and we don't look at it as a drug, and it really can be. We learned in school that alcohol is one of the hardest things to break and to kick. It's one of the worst withdrawal periods. It can kill you quicker than other things like heroin or cocaine or meth. So we got to be very mindful of that, man. **[Deuteronomy 28:47-48](/bible/deuteronomy/28#v47)** *[[24:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38&t=1490s)]* > [47](/bible/deuteronomy/28#v47) Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things; > > [48](/bible/deuteronomy/28#v48) Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee. - But all this happened because we broke God's commandments. At the end of the day, we broke God's commandments. - Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart: we didn't want to serve the Lord. We did not want to serve the Lord. Throughout history, ain't just now, but throughout history, we had a problem with serving the Lord with gladness. - Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies: and with that, we going to serve our enemies. And with that, our oppressor is going to use strong drink and wine to destroy the nation of Israel. And he's done it for centuries. - Until he have destroyed thee: our people are destroyed. Our people are destroyed. Alcohol is used by Satan to numb pain instead of healing. Replace discipline with escapism. Destroys men's leadership. Brothers, when they drink wine, they don't think properly. They don't make sound judgments and things like that. And it keeps the nation of Israel from rising, from us getting back together. I'm telling you, man, it's hard. You can't go out and talk to a drunk person. But guess what? You see on the east side, Oklahoma City, wherever a Martin Luther King is at, it's a drunk person, homeless. In any city we go to, that's a problem, right? **[Hosea 4:11](/bible/hosea/4#v11)** *[[26:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38&t=1607s)]* > [11](/bible/hosea/4#v11) Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart. - We going to wrap this up. But listen, if you know your limit and drinking ain't it for you, don't drink. Do not drink. Don't drink at all. Even though it's lawful, it might not be expedient for you to drink. Because it's an addiction. Alcohol is an addiction. It can be an addiction. So, you got to be able to choose how you do things, right? - Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart: take do what? Take away the heart. You see how it says the wine and women? It goes hand in hand. It destroys the black, Hispanic, and Native American man and woman. It destroys us. So, we got to be mindful of that, man. But the Lord did not tempt you. Lord ain't tempt us to do it. We just got to be mindful. We got to know how to use it. **[Sirach 2:1](/bible/sirach/2#v1)** *[[28:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38&t=1693s)]* > [1](/bible/sirach/2#v1) My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation. - This what we must know. At the end of the day, this place is a place of healing. This is a hospital. We here to help you. If you're having those issues, you have issues with strong drink or alcohol or whatever the case may be, we are here to help you. This is a hospital, and our job is to make sure that we are healing our people with the word of God. But don't get it twisted. You're going to be tried. You're going to be tested. Period. The devil is going to try you and test you. You got to be prepared when you come here. - Prepare thy soul for temptation: you got to prepare your soul for temptation, because it's going to happen. It's going to happen. Alcoholism is not a life sentence. It is a stronghold that can be broken through discipline, brotherhood, accountability, fear of the Lord, and keeping the commandments. Alcohol doesn't just attack the body. It attacks the mission of Israel. ## In Closing *[[29:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38&t=1762s)]* So, be mindful of that, y'all. If you ain't that person that need a drink, damn it, don't do it. All right. Shalom, most high and Christ bless. --- [15 Minutes Index](/captains) · [Watch the full session on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAbD6jwnU38)
